name: The Travails
description: The near-apocalypse on Innistrad when a monster in the moon nearly ended the plane.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
timeline.quote: "My uncle died the day the town became the Town.

pages_say.description: A catastrophe when Avacyn fell and wolfir overran the woods.
A disturbance after which the nights grew longer and the days too short.
The catastrophe that broke Innistrad, warped holy places and swelled the ranks of the undead.
The earlier catastrophe that the aftermath of the massacre reminds Arlinn of.
The catastrophe that ruined Innistrad, felling Gavony and the angels.
The catastrophe after which magic became harder and the Plane fell apart.
The catastrophe before which Torens served as a Mausoleum Guard.
The earlier catastrophe in which friend and foe were hard to tell apart.
The near-apocalypse on Innistrad when a monster in the moon nearly ended the plane.
